sections.heading: Using CV Maker
sections.body: You may use CV Maker to create, edit, and export resumes for lawful personal or professional purposes.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: You remain responsible for the accuracy, legality, and ownership of the information you enter or export. Do not enter content you are not allowed to use.

sections.heading: No guarantee
sections.body: Templates and guidance are provided as tools. CV Maker does not guarantee interviews, employment, or compatibility with every recruitment system.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: Features may be improved, changed, or discontinued. We aim to keep the service useful and available but cannot promise uninterrupted access.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to info@dhakalkiran.com.np.
